message: build-vs-buy: this looks like building a capability often already solved by a battle-tested library or service — before writing it, weigh take (adopt) vs wrap vs write via an existing-solution search, health table, and verdict; skip only if you already know no fit exists

lane.trigger: prompt head carries a making verb AND a commodity-capability noun (auth, queue, cache, parser, rate-limiter, ...)

message: ℹ approaches: an irreversible command, or an attempt that has already been made more than once — stop and get a second opinion before you run it

lane.trigger: prompt head matches (tried everything|third time) OR an irreversible command token (rm -rf|reset --hard|drop table|migrate:fresh|delete all|force.push)
